2607.25626.title: Joint Text-Audio Alignment for EEG-to-Text Decoding in Chinese Speech Production and Perception
2607.25626.paper_summary: Decoding speech information directly from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) into text provides a potential non-invasive neural communication pathway for individuals with severe speech and motor impairments. Compared with invasive approaches such as electrocorticography, EEG is safer and more widely deployable, yet substantially more challenging to decode.This challenge is exacerbated for Chinese sentence decoding, which must handle a high-dimensional output space with thousands of characters, severe inter-subject variability, and low signal-to-noise ratios for text alignment.Existing methods commit to a single supervisory axis---either text semantics or audio acoustic features---yet neither can simultaneously satisfy the demands of sentence-level discriminability and fine-grained temporal resolution required for large-vocabulary Chinese decoding. We introduce EEGAlign, a novel parameter-efficient framework that jointly aligns EEG with two axes---text alignment with BGE-M3 text embeddings and audio alignment with wav2vec~2.0 speech features via contrastive learning followed by CTC character-sequence decoding. On ChineseEEG-2 data, EEGAlign yields state-of-the-art closed-set sentence classification performance, reaching up to 82.37% Top-1 accuracy on Reading Aloud EEG and 41.43% on Passive Listening EEG out of 101 candidates. Ablation studies show that the two alignment axes are highly complementary: combining them yields consistently better performance than either alone. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study on decoding large-vocabulary Chinese sentences from non-invasive EEG during overt speech production, and achieving strong classification performance with relatively large closed-set candidate-sentence setting.
2607.25626.paper_summary_zh: 直接從頭皮腦電圖（EEG）解碼語音信息為文本，為嚴重語音和運動障礙的個體提供了一種潛在的非侵入性神經通信途徑。與侵入性方法如皮層電圖相比，EEG更安全且更廣泛可部署，但解碼的挑戰卻大得多。這一挑戰在中文句子的解碼中更加嚴峻，因為它必須處理高維輸出空間，擁有數千個字符，並且文本對齊的信號與噪聲比率低，存在嚴重的個體變異性。現有方法專注於單一的監督軸——要麼是文本語義，要麼是音頻聲學特徵——但兩者都無法同時滿足大詞彙中文解碼所需的句子級可區分性和細粒度時間分辨率。我們介紹了EEGAlign，一種新穎的參數高效框架，將EEG與兩個軸進行聯合對齊——與BGE-M3文本嵌入的文本對齊，以及通過對比學習與wav2vec~2.0語音特徵的音頻對齊，隨後進行CTC字符序列解碼。在ChineseEEG-2數據上，EEGAlign實現了最先進的封閉集句子分類性能，在朗讀EEG上達到82.37%的Top-1準確率，在被動聆聽EEG上達到41.43%，共101個候選者。消融研究表明，這兩個對齊軸是高度互補的：結合它們的性能始終優於單獨使用任一軸。據我們所知，這是第一項研究從非侵入性EEG中解碼大詞彙中文句子於明顯語音產生過程中，並在相對較大的封閉集候選句子設置中實現強大的分類性能的研究。
